answer: At network dawn, each agent mints its identity by burning a compute puzzle whose difficulty doubles per existing credential: the first proof costs ~10 GPU-hours, the second ~20, the tenth ~5,120. An attacker trying to forge N sybils faces exponential cost (2^N), while honest agents pay once. A forged identity that fails a random re-verification puzzle within 24 hours is burned and emits a slash signal to peers, voiding its vouching power permanently.
